answer: VDF timing proofs at the opal: each identity must solve a sequential delay before its work counts, and submissions arrive through the inlet only if the timing proof verifies. Every pulse of the epoch clock enforces this, so a farm of n identities pays n× the wall-clock delay. Cost scales linearly with identities while no parallel speedup exists; the delay is inherently serial, making 1000 sybils 1000× slower, not faster. Attacker ROI collapses because honest single nodes finish in one delay window.
